subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI client-side completion notification contract, and which modes, platform backends, and config surface should it support?
rationale: This request adds new user-facing behavior and likely config surface rather than repairing a broken existing TUI contract, and adjacent plugin/node notification seams do not settle the local TUI product boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrow TUI notifier
options.body: Add a default-off TUI-owned notifier for completion events, with terminal bell as the smallest cross-platform mode and desktop/sound support only if maintainers accept the platform and security constraints.

options.title: Defer to broader alerting design
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for the gateway session activity/watchdog direction before choosing notification payloads, cooldowns, and delivery behavior.

options.title: Route to plugins or nodes only
options.body: Decline core TUI notification behavior and document agent_end or nodes notify as the supported extension path, accepting that Gateway-connected TUI clients may not be notified on the local machine.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Add a default-off TUI-owned notifier for completion events, with terminal bell as the smallest cross-platform mode and desktop/sound support only if maintainers accept the platform and security constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal around the TUI status surface and is the best available owner for the product boundary choice.
